description: The Phase 13 lit house with four saved views, read by an implementation of FS_views that knows it: a 24 mm two-point hero shot from the south-west on a June evening, a 20 mm two-point view of the Kitchen's island at f/2.8 with every light on, a two-point view from the garden at dusk with the lights as FS_lighting's "Evening" scene sets them - FS_lighting unknown to it, its scenes read as data - and a square view from high above with the roof and ceilings cut away above L1. It is valid, reports nothing, and derives each view's name, level, lights and scene.
